name: What should I prepare before meeting with a kitchen remodeling contractor?

mainEntity.name: What should I prepare before meeting with a kitchen remodeling contractor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Before contacting a contractor, take rough measurements of your space, inventory your storage needs, and decide on major appliance dimensions. Collect clear reference images of your preferred cabinet styles, tile patterns, and molding details. It is also important to identify any existing issues you want resolved, such as poor lighting, inadequate electrical outlets for small appliances, or uneven subfloors. Having a clear idea of your appliance specifications before framing begins ensures that cabinet openings and rough-in locations are placed accurately from the start.
acceptedAnswer.description: Gather rough room measurements, choose appliance dimensions, assemble visual style preferences, and list functional problems with your current layout.
